expected_outcome: List of files and locations where color schemes are defined or used.
description: Identify color variables or hardcoded color values in the existing codebase. Focus on files related to UI elements (UIScene.js), game over screen (GameOverScene.js), and potentially the main game configuration (main.js) or specific sprites if they have defined colors.

expected_outcome: A defined color palette with at least 4-5 distinct colors.
description: Define a new color palette. This could be a set of named color variables in a separate configuration file (e.g., config/theme.js) or within the main game configuration. Consider primary, secondary, background, and accent colors.

expected_outcome: Updated codebase using the new color palette, maintaining visual consistency.
description: Modify the identified files to use the new color palette. Replace hardcoded color values with the corresponding color variables from the defined palette. Ensure consistency in the color scheme across different UI elements and game scenes.

expected_outcome: Game displays correctly with the updated color scheme, and no visual errors or inconsistencies are present.
description: Test the game with the new color scheme. Verify that all UI elements, scenes, and sprites display the colors correctly and that the new color scheme is visually appealing and functional.
